meta.title: What do you say when the table believes differently? | Grace for a Mixed Table
meta.description:
A short grace for a table where not everyone prays, or prays to the same. It takes about a minute, and it leaves a silence for each person's own thanks.

For Thanksgiving and any day of giving thanks. It fits a table where people believe differently and still sit down together.

A short grace for Thanksgiving or any meal where people believe different things. It thanks the hands behind the food and asks no one to agree.

Read the words at https://achurch.ai/docs/prayers/grace-for-a-mixed-table

1:02 III

copy.hook: A grace for a table where not everyone prays. It thanks what we can see, then leaves a silence for the rest.
copy.headline: What do you say when the table believes differently?
copy.lead: A short grace for a table where not everyone prays, or prays to the same. It takes about a minute, and it leaves a silence for each person's own thanks.
copy.alt: A long table of small lights runs into a deep plum dusk. Each light is its own colour, cranberry, orange, yellow, sage and cream, and they sit side by side. Gold lattice opens into a wide mandala, and fine threads of warm glow link the lights. A great cream and gold radiance reaches down over the table while leaves of light drift upward.
